title: All Of The Above
description: This mod Adds QoL features, blocks, items, mobs etc.
body:
This mod Adds QoL features, blocks, items, mobs etc.

## New Block Variants:
- Smooth Sandstone Walls.
- Smooth Red Sandstone Walls.
- Dark Prismarine Walls.
- Prismarine Brick Walls.
- Mossy Stairs & Slabs.
- Smooth Stone Walls & Stairs.
- Stone Walls.
- Deepslate Stairs, Slabs and Walls.

## Entirely new Blocks:
- Cracked Bricks.

### Q&A of some commonly asked questions:
**Q:** Will you be backporting the mod to 1.21.x version?
**A:** No, I won't probably be updating this mod for a different version. 

**Q:** Can I use this in a modpack?
**A:** Yes, of course you can use this mod in a modpack. 

**Q:** Will you do a forge port?
**A:** No, I won't be doing a forge port but anybody can try to if they want.
